# Mongolia (.mn), 0.2.0-dev.1 development compiler

Compiler: mn. Native AI. Native Performance. This tagline is a mission, not a benchmark.
Read SPEC.md, grammar.ebnf, ARCHITECTURE.md, STATUS.md and BUILD_REPORT.md before generating code.

Supported: fn/функц, let/хувьсагч, return/буцаах, print/хэвлэх, true/үнэн,
false/худал; types i64/бүхэл64, f64/бодит64, bool/логик, string/мөр,
Tensor/Тензор and unit (). Additional reserved aliases (syntax proposed): mut/өөрчлөгдөх, const/тогтмол, if/хэрэв,
else/үгүйбол, loop/давтах, while/зуур, for/бүр, in/дотор, break/зогсох,
continue/үргэлжлэх, struct/бүтэц, enum/тоочилт, trait/шинж, impl/хэрэгжүүлэх,
import/импорт, pub/нийтийн, grad/уламжлал, f32/бодит32, i32/бүхэл32.
NFC XID identifiers; avoid Latin/Cyrillic inside a single name and confusable name collisions.
Mixed-language keywords are allowed. Functions have typed parameters and explicit returns.
Bindings are immutable. Arithmetic is exact-type i64 or f64; integer overflow traps.
Tensor cells must be f64, rectangular and nonempty; static rank two only.
Tensor<f64,[M,N]> uses positive integer dimensions. A[M,K] @ B[K,N] -> C[M,N].
Explicit i64(e) and f64(e), including their Mongolian aliases, accept numeric operands. See LANGUAGE_SPECIFICATION_UPDATE.md.
No implicit scalar conversions, broadcasting, control flow, dynamic shapes, native AD, GPU,
FFI, imports, package management, ownership checking or standard library module APIs yet.
print is the implemented output primitive. Future documents are not executable specifications.

Valid source:
fn add(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { return a + b; }
функц main() { хувьсагч x = add(12, 30); хэвлэх(x); }

Valid tensor source:
fn main() { let A = [[1.0, 2.0]]; let B = [[3.0], [4.0]]; print(A @ B); }

Tensor + - * / are elementwise for identical shapes only; unary minus accepts only i64 and f64.
Commands: mn run FILE; mn check FILE; mn init [DIRECTORY]; mn --help; mn --version.
Diagnostics: --lang en or --lang mn. Unsupported commands return errors.
Common errors: undefined names, duplicate bindings, ragged tensors, wrong argument count,
wrong parameter/return type, incompatible inner tensor dimensions, missing semicolons/braces.
No tests or performance claims may be invented. This file is guidance; AI assistants are not
assumed to discover or obey it automatically. See AGENTS.md for repository contribution rules.
